title: Common Form Digital Goods
goal: Make simulated digital commerce transparent, reversible, and inspectable.

behavior.user_goal: Evaluate terms and complete a no-charge checkout without coercion.
behavior.recovery: deterministic checkout failure preserves state and permits retry

design.rationale: editorial commerce hierarchy, visible state, accessible recovery

frontend_data_flow: catalog data → domain modules → DOM projection → local non-sensitive cart
target_data_flow: web → API boundary → commerce use cases → repository/payment ports → infrastructure adapters → audit events
